name: Infiltrating the Castle: the map and the in-world tracker both mark Tyrion in the keep garden (#7005)
contract: Quest 2745 'Infiltrating the Castle' has one POI (id 0, ObjectiveIndex -1) with a single point. CoA moved Tyrion 7766 to the keep roof garden (-8330, 279.5) in rev_20260923_03_coa_stormwind.sql but the marker still points at the stock spot (-8408, 451), ~188 yd away outside the walls. This case asks the server for 2745's points with the CMSG_QUEST_POI_QUERY a real client sends and reads SMSG_QUEST_POI_QUERY_RESPONSE itself. The answer must hold one POI whose single point is Tyrion's garden spot (-8330, 280). The reporter follows the arrow in the world, and that is a second, independent route: the client resolves the in-world tracker and the minimap pin from its own QuestSuperTrack.dbc and SuperTrack.dbc rows, and the core streams SuperTrack.dbc rows from coa_client_super_track to the client at login (SMSG_PATCH_SUPER_TRACK, 0x06BE). QuestSuperTrack row 234 (quest 2745) resolves completion to SuperTrack node 164, which the client ships at the stock spot (-8409.0, 450.793, 123.76) - the ground CoA cut away - and quest 2746 shares that node. The last assertions read the login patch stream and require row 164 to stand on Tyrion's garden at MapID 0 with the client's own radius 5.5 and NextID 0. These are data assertions rather than a run: the harness cannot see what the client draws.
